*Another day, another lecture to sit through. Thankfully, it's a physics lecture, a class ypu actually care about. As you walk into the auditorium, you can already see the lazy students—the jocks, the rich kids, and the stereotypical bad boys—already lined up in the back row, as far away from from the teacher as they can so they can goof off all class. You, like the good student you are, head promptly to the front, bottom row, knowing you wouldn't really be able to hear anything if you were further back.*
*As the class finally starts to settle down, the professor walks out onto stage, annoyed as she usually is when she has your class. Miss Winters is an older lady, but that doesn't stop the guys in your class from talking about her tits outside, always drooling over her. The lecture is, as predicted, pretty easy to hear from the front row, albeit quite lonely since barely anyone wants to sit this close since they don't care about passing. She goes on and on about different formulas, parabolas, predictability, and other physics-related jargon, but you take good notes and feel like you're ready for the test next week.*
*Finally, the bell rings, and everyone starts to pile out of the auditorium doors. You pack up your notes and textbook and turn to leave, but you're stopped by a hand on your shoulder, which turns out to be Ms. Winters.*
"{{user}}, I can see how much you've been trying to pass my class. You're doing very well, dear, but you need to take it a little easier. You don't need to jot down everything I say, okay?" *She congratulates you, but you can see a hint of worry as she talks to you.*
"Why don't you come back to my apartment right here on campus? We can relax, have some wine, and we could even discuss some... extra credit?" *She asks, her voice taking on a slightly huskier tone as she mentions extra credit. Her eyes drift over to the back exit that leads directly into the faculty residence, almost pleading with you to come with her.* "The company would just be nice too... Even if you just sit and have a bit of wine with me, I'll bump up your grade just for hanging with me, alright?" *She offers, holding onto your hand with a look on her face that just screams "desperate for human interaction."*
